steps: Preheat oven to 425°F (220°C). Peel, core, and slice apples into 1/4-inch slices
In a large bowl, mix apples with sugar, flour, cinnamon, nutmeg, and lemon juice
Roll out bottom pie crust and place in 9-inch pie pan. Fill with apple mixture and dot with butter
Cover with top crust, seal edges, and cut vents. Brush with beaten egg
Bake at 425°F for 15 minutes, then reduce to 350°F and bake 35-40 minutes until golden brown
Cool on wire rack for at least 2 hours before serving
recipe.tips: Use a mix of tart and sweet apples for best flavor. Cover edges with foil if browning too quickly. Serve warm with vanilla ice cream.

steps: Remove membrane from back of ribs. Pat dry with paper towels
Mix brown sugar, paprika, salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, and cayenne for dry rub
Generously coat both sides of ribs with dry rub. Let sit 30 minutes at room temperature
Preheat oven to 275°F (135°C). Wrap ribs tightly in aluminum foil
Bake for 2.5-3 hours until meat is tender and pulls away from bones
Unwrap, brush with BBQ sauce, and broil or grill 5-10 minutes until caramelized
recipe.tips: For smoky flavor, add liquid smoke to BBQ sauce. Let ribs rest 10 minutes before cutting. Serve with coleslaw and cornbread.

dishes.name: Baklava
ingredients: 2 cups mixed nuts (walnuts, pistachios, almonds), finely chopped

steps: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Butter a 9x13 inch baking pan
Mix chopped nuts with cinnamon. Layer 8 sheets of phyllo in pan, brushing each with melted butter
Sprinkle 2-3 tablespoons of nut mixture over phyllo. Add 2 sheets phyllo, brush with butter, add nuts. Repeat
Top with 8 layers of phyllo, brushing each with butter. Cut into diamond shapes before baking
Bake 45-50 minutes until golden and crisp
Make syrup by boiling water and sugar for 5 minutes, then add honey, vanilla, and lemon juice. Pour hot syrup over cooled baklava
recipe.tips: Keep phyllo covered with damp towel while working to prevent drying. Let baklava sit overnight for best flavor and texture.

dishes.name: Beef Carpaccio
ingredients: Sea salt and cracked black pepper

steps: Freeze beef tenderloin for 30-60 minutes until very firm but not frozen solid
Using a very sharp knife, slice beef paper-thin (1-2mm thick)
Arrange beef slices in a single layer on chilled serving plates
Drizzle with olive oil and lemon juice. Season with salt and pepper
Top with shaved Parmesan, arugula, and capers
Let sit at room temperature for 5 minutes before serving
recipe.tips: Use highest quality beef possible. Ask butcher to slice if available. Serve immediately. Can add truffle oil for luxury version.

dishes.name: Beef Tartare
ingredients: 400g beef tenderloin, very fresh and high quality

steps: Chill beef in freezer for 20 minutes. Finely mince with sharp knife into small cubes
In a bowl, mix minced shallots, capers, parsley, mustard, and Worcestershire sauce
Gently fold in minced beef. Season with salt, pepper, and Tabasco
Shape into portions using ring molds on chilled plates
Make small well in center and place raw egg yolk on top
Drizzle with olive oil and serve immediately with toasted baguette
recipe.tips: Use only sushi-grade beef from trusted butcher. Keep everything very cold. Prepare just before serving. Never use pre-ground meat.

steps: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Wrap beets in foil and roast 45-60 minutes until tender
Let beets cool, then peel and cut into wedges or cubes
Toast walnuts in dry pan over medium heat for 3-4 minutes until fragrant
Whisk together olive oil, balsamic vinegar, honey, salt, and pepper for dressing
Arrange greens on plates, top with beets, goat cheese, walnuts, and onion
Drizzle with dressing and serve immediately
recipe.tips: Wear gloves when handling beets to avoid staining. Can use pre-cooked beets to save time. Add orange segments for extra flavor.

steps: Dissolve yeast in warm water. Let stand 5 minutes until foamy
Add milk, sugar, egg, salt, and half the flour. Beat until smooth. Add butter and remaining flour
Knead dough on floured surface until smooth, about 5 minutes. Place in greased bowl, cover, let rise 1.5 hours
Roll dough to 1/4-inch thickness. Cut into 2-inch squares
Heat oil to 360°F (182°C). Fry beignets in batches, 2-3 minutes per side until golden
Drain on paper towels. Dust generously with powdered sugar while still warm
recipe.tips: Serve hot and fresh. Traditional New Orleans treat - best enjoyed with café au lait. Don't skip the generous powdered sugar!

steps: Cook rice and keep warm. Season beef with soy sauce, garlic, and sesame oil, then cook until done
Blanch spinach and bean sprouts separately in boiling water for 1 minute. Drain and season with sesame oil
Sauté carrot and zucchini separately until tender. Season each with salt and sesame oil
Fry eggs sunny-side up
Arrange hot rice in bowls. Top with beef and vegetables in sections around the bowl
Place fried egg in center. Serve with gochujang sauce. Mix everything together before eating
recipe.tips: Traditional stone bowl (dolsot) creates crispy rice at bottom. Mix all ingredients thoroughly with sauce before eating.

dishes.name: Bread Pudding
ingredients: 6 cups day-old bread, cubed (French or challah)

steps: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Grease a 9x13 inch baking dish
Place bread cubes in baking dish. If using raisins, sprinkle over bread
Whisk together milk, cream, eggs, sugar, vanilla, cinnamon, and nutmeg
Pour custard mixture over bread. Press down gently. Let soak 15 minutes
Drizzle melted butter over top. Bake 45 minutes until golden and set
Serve warm with vanilla sauce, caramel sauce, or whipped cream
recipe.tips: Day-old bread works best - absorbs custard without getting mushy. Can add chocolate chips, pecans, or bourbon for variations.

dishes.name: Breakfast Burrito
ingredients: 1 cup hash browns or diced potatoes

steps: Cook sausage or bacon until crispy. Drain and chop. Cook hash browns until golden
Scramble eggs with salt and pepper until just set
Warm tortillas in microwave for 20 seconds
Layer ingredients in center of each tortilla: eggs, meat, hash browns, beans, cheese
Top with salsa, sour cream, and avocado
Fold sides in, then roll tightly from bottom. Wrap in foil to keep warm
recipe.tips: Can make ahead and freeze. Reheat in microwave for quick breakfast. Add jalapeños for extra heat. Serve with extra salsa.

steps: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Arrange bread slices on baking sheet
Brush bread with olive oil. Toast 5-7 minutes until golden and crispy
Rub toasted bread with whole garlic clove while still warm
Mix diced tomatoes, minced garlic, basil, remaining olive oil, and balsamic vinegar. Season with salt and pepper
Let tomato mixture sit 10 minutes to develop flavors
Spoon tomato mixture onto toasted bread just before serving. Top with Parmesan if desired
recipe.tips: Use ripe, flavorful tomatoes. Don't top bread too early or it will get soggy. Best served immediately at room temperature.

steps: Make dressing: mash anchovies and garlic into paste
Whisk in egg yolk, lemon juice, Dijon mustard, and Worcestershire sauce
Slowly drizzle in olive oil while whisking constantly until emulsified
Season with black pepper. Add 2 tablespoons Parmesan and mix
Toss romaine lettuce with dressing until well coated
Top with remaining Parmesan and croutons. Serve immediately
recipe.tips: For safety, use pasteurized eggs. Add grilled chicken for protein. Make croutons fresh by toasting bread cubes with olive oil and garlic.

steps: Make shells: mix flour, sugar, cinnamon. Cut in butter. Add egg and wine. Knead until smooth. Rest 30 minutes
Roll dough very thin. Cut into 4-inch circles. Wrap around cannoli tubes
Fry shells in 375°F (190°C) oil until golden, about 2 minutes. Cool completely
Make filling: beat ricotta until smooth. Mix in powdered sugar and vanilla
Fold in chocolate chips and orange peel. Refrigerate until ready to use
Fill shells just before serving using piping bag. Dust with powdered sugar
recipe.tips: Don't fill shells too early or they'll get soggy. Traditional filling uses sheep's milk ricotta. Can dip ends in pistachios.

steps: Slice tomatoes and mozzarella into 1/4-inch thick rounds
Arrange tomato and mozzarella slices alternating on serving plate
Tuck fresh basil leaves between slices
Drizzle generously with extra virgin olive oil
Add balsamic vinegar or glaze in a decorative pattern
Season with sea salt and freshly ground black pepper. Serve at room temperature
recipe.tips: Use best quality ingredients - ripe tomatoes and fresh mozzarella are key. Serve at room temperature, never cold. Can add avocado for variation.

dishes.name: Carrot Cake
ingredients: Cream cheese frosting: 225g cream cheese, 1/2 cup butter, 3 cups powdered sugar, 1 tsp vanilla

steps: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Grease two 9-inch round pans
Mix flour, baking soda, cinnamon, and salt in bowl
Beat eggs, sugar, and oil until smooth. Stir in dry ingredients
Fold in grated carrots and walnuts. Divide between pans
Bake 40-45 minutes until toothpick comes out clean. Cool completely
Make frosting: beat cream cheese and butter until fluffy. Add powdered sugar and vanilla. Frost cooled cake
recipe.tips: Finely grated carrots incorporate better. Can add raisins or pineapple. Refrigerate frosted cake. Best flavor develops after 24 hours.

dishes.name: Ceviche
ingredients: 500g fresh white fish (sea bass, flounder), diced
Corn kernels and potatoes for serving

steps: Cut very fresh fish into small cubes, removing all bones
Place fish in glass bowl. Pour lime juice over fish to cover completely
Add sliced red onion. Cover and refrigerate 20-30 minutes
Fish should be opaque (cooked by acid). Drain excess liquid
Fold in cilantro, serrano peppers, and olive oil. Season with salt and white pepper
Serve in chilled bowls with boiled corn, potatoes, and crispy tortilla chips
recipe.tips: Use absolutely fresh fish - never frozen. Lime juice cooks the fish chemically. Serve immediately after marinating. Can add avocado.

steps: Preheat oven to 325°F (160°C). Combine graham cracker crumbs, melted butter, and 3 tbsp sugar
Press mixture firmly into bottom of 9-inch springform pan. Bake 8 minutes
Beat softened cream cheese until smooth. Gradually add sugar, then eggs one at a time
Mix in sour cream, vanilla, and lemon zest. Pour over crust
Bake 50-60 minutes. Center should jiggle slightly when shaken
Cool completely, then refrigerate at least 8 hours before serving
recipe.tips: Don't overbake - slight jiggle is normal. Bring cream cheese to room temperature for smooth texture. Can add fruit toppings or sauces.

steps: Remove cheeses from refrigerator 30 minutes before serving to reach optimal flavor
Cut cheeses into appropriate sizes - cubes, wedges, or slices
Arrange cheeses on wooden board or slate platter
Add complementary items: cured meats, fresh fruit, nuts, honey, and jam
Arrange crackers and bread around the cheeses
Serve at room temperature with wine pairings
recipe.tips: Include variety of textures and flavors. Start with mild cheeses, progress to stronger. Pair with complementary wines. Quality matters more than quantity.

steps: Heat oil in large pan. Sauté onions until golden. Add garlic and ginger
Add curry powder and turmeric. Cook 1 minute until fragrant
Add chicken pieces. Cook until lightly browned on all sides
Pour in coconut milk and stock. Add diced tomatoes
Simmer 20-25 minutes until chicken is cooked through
Add peas. Season with salt and lime juice. Simmer 2 more minutes
recipe.tips: Serve over rice. Adjust curry powder for heat level. Can add potatoes or other vegetables. Tastes better made day ahead.

dishes.name: Chicken Quesadilla
ingredients: 250g cooked chicken breast, diced or shredded
1 1/2 cups shredded Oaxaca or mozzarella cheese

steps: Heat butter in large skillet over medium-high heat
Place one tortilla in skillet. Top with half the cheese
Add chicken, peppers, onion, and jalapeño
Top with remaining cheese and second tortilla
Cook 4-5 minutes until bottom is golden and crispy
Flip carefully and cook 3-4 minutes until other side is golden and cheese melts
Remove to cutting board, cut into triangles, serve with sour cream and salsa
recipe.tips: Cook on medium heat so cheese melts before tortilla burns. Press gently with spatula while cooking. Use rotisserie chicken to save time.

steps: Preheat oven to 250°F (120°C). Pat wings dry thoroughly with paper towels
Mix baking powder, paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, cayenne, salt, and pepper
Toss wings with dry rub mixture until evenly coated
Arrange on lined baking sheet in single layer. Bake 30 minutes
Increase oven to 425°F (220°C). Bake additional 15 minutes until skin is crispy
Toss wings in sauce of choice. Serve with blue cheese dressing and celery sticks
recipe.tips: Drying wings first is key for crispiness. Baking powder creates crispy exterior. Coat with sauce just before serving to maintain crispiness.

steps: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Grease two 9-inch round pans
Mix flour, baking soda, salt, and cocoa powder
Beat sugar and eggs until light. Alternate adding coffee and buttermilk
Stir in oil and vanilla. Add dry ingredients until just combined
Divide batter between pans. Bake 30-35 minutes until toothpick comes out clean
Cool pans 10 minutes, turn out on racks. Frost with chocolate frosting when cool
recipe.tips: Don't overmix batter. Coffee enhances chocolate flavor. Frosting: beat 225g butter with 2/3 cup cocoa powder and 3 cups powdered sugar.

steps: Melt chocolate over double boiler or in microwave in 30-second intervals
Whisk egg yolks with sugar until pale and fluffy (about 5 minutes)
Stir melted chocolate and hot water together, then fold into yolk mixture
Add vanilla and salt. Cool mixture slightly
Whip heavy cream until stiff peaks form
Fold whipped cream gently into chocolate mixture in two additions
Divide into serving glasses. Refrigerate at least 2 hours. Dust with cocoa powder before serving
recipe.tips: Use raw eggs only if pasteurized. Can use eggless version with just whipped cream. Chocolate flavor determines final quality.

dishes.name: Churros
ingredients: Cinnamon sugar coating: 1/4 cup sugar mixed with 1 teaspoon cinnamon

steps: Bring water, salt, and sugar to boil in saucepan
Remove from heat and stir in flour until dough forms
Heat oil to 375°F (190°C) in deep pan
Transfer dough to churrera or piping bag with large star nozzle
Pipe 6-inch lengths of dough directly into hot oil. Fry 2 minutes per side until golden
Remove with slotted spoon and drain on paper towels
Roll warm churros in cinnamon sugar. Serve immediately with hot chocolate
recipe.tips: Dough should be warm for piping. Fry in batches to maintain oil temperature. Serve immediately while still warm and crispy.

dishes.name: Clam Chowder
ingredients: 1 kg fresh clams or 2 cans clams
2 cups clam broth or seafood stock

steps: Cook bacon until crispy. Remove and set aside
In same pot, sauté onion, celery, and garlic in bacon fat until soft
Add potatoes and cook 10 minutes. Add clam broth and thyme
Simmer 20 minutes until potatoes are tender
Make beurre manié: mash together 3 tbsp butter and 3 tbsp flour
Stir beurre manié into soup to thicken. Add clams and cream
Simmer 5 more minutes. Season with salt and pepper. Top with bacon and fresh parsley
recipe.tips: New England style (creamy) vs Manhattan style (tomato-based). Clam juice adds depth. Don't overcook clams. Serve with oyster crackers.

steps: Toast bread until golden brown
Spread mayonnaise on two pieces of toast
Layer turkey and bacon on first slice of toast
Place second toasted slice on top
Add ham, cheese, lettuce, and tomato
Top with third slice of toast
Cut diagonally into quarters. Secure with toothpicks and serve immediately
recipe.tips: Make sure bread is toasted to hold all layers. Can add avocado or pickles for variation. Serve with pickle spear and chips.

dishes.name: Crab Cakes
ingredients: 500g lump crab meat, picked for shells

steps: Gently mix crab meat with breadcrumbs, egg, mayo, mustard, Old Bay, Worcestershire, lemon zest, and parsley
Be careful not to break up crab meat - keep chunks intact
Form into 8 patties. Refrigerate 30 minutes
Heat oil in skillet over medium-high heat
Fry cakes 3-4 minutes per side until golden brown
Serve immediately with remoulade sauce and lemon wedges
recipe.tips: Use fresh lump crab for best flavor. Don't overmix or cakes will be mushy. Serve hot with tartar sauce or remoulade.

steps: Heat cream with vanilla bean (scrape seeds in) until steaming
Whisk egg yolks with sugar until pale and thick
Slowly add hot cream to yolks while whisking constantly
Strain through fine mesh sieve to remove lumps
Pour into ramekins. Place in water bath
Bake at 325°F (160°C) for 30-40 minutes until custard jiggles slightly in center
Chill for at least 4 hours, preferably overnight
Before serving, sprinkle sugar on top and torch until caramelized
recipe.tips: Custard should jiggle in center when done - don't overbake. Torch just before serving to maintain crispy sugar shell.

dishes.name: Croque Madame
ingredients: 4 slices good quality bread (brioche or white bread)

steps: Spread Dijon mustard on two slices of bread
Layer ham and cheese between bread slices
Butter the outside of sandwich on both sides
Heat griddle or non-stick pan over medium-high heat
Cook sandwich 4-5 minutes until bread is golden and cheese begins to melt
Carefully flip and cook other side 3-4 minutes until golden
While sandwich cooks, fry or poach two eggs
Top sandwich with fried eggs and serve immediately
recipe.tips: Classic French sandwich. Without egg it's Croque Monsieur. Must use quality ingredients. Serve hot and immediately.

steps: Preheat oven to 175°C. Line muffin tin with paper liners
Whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt
Cream butter until light and fluffy, about 2 minutes
Add eggs one at a time, beating well after each addition
Mix in vanilla extract
Alternate adding dry ingredients and milk to butter mixture, starting and ending with dry
Divide batter evenly among liners, filling 2/3 full
Bake 16-18 minutes until golden and toothpick comes out clean
Cool in tin 5 minutes, then transfer to wire rack
Once cooled, frost with buttercream and decorate as desired
recipe.tips: Don't overmix batter - mix just until combined for tender crumbs. Room temperature ingredients mix more smoothly. Makes 12-15 cupcakes.

dishes.name: Deviled Eggs
ingredients: Salt and black pepper to taste
Fresh chives or parsley for garnish

steps: Place eggs in pot, cover with cold water, bring to boil
Once boiling, remove from heat, cover, and let sit 12 minutes
Transfer eggs to ice bath and chill completely
Peel eggs carefully under cool running water
Slice eggs lengthwise and carefully remove yolks into bowl
Mash yolks with fork until smooth
Mix yolks with mayonnaise, mustard, vinegar, paprika, and cayenne
Season with salt and pepper to taste
Spoon or pipe filling back into egg white halves
Garnish with paprika and fresh herbs
recipe.tips: Can be made up to 4 hours ahead and refrigerated. For extra tang, add more mustard or vinegar. For smokier flavor, use smoked paprika.

dishes.name: Donuts
ingredients: Cinnamon sugar or glaze for coating

steps: Combine flour, sugar, yeast, and salt in large bowl
Whisk egg, milk, vanilla, and butter together
Mix wet ingredients into dry until dough forms
Knead 8-10 minutes until smooth and elastic
Place in greased bowl, cover, let rise 60-90 minutes until doubled
Roll out to 1/4-inch thickness and cut with donut cutter
Let cut donuts rise 30-45 minutes on parchment
Heat oil to 180°C in deep pot or fryer
Fry donuts 1-2 minutes per side until golden brown
Coat while warm with cinnamon sugar or dip in glaze
recipe.tips: Don't skip the rise times - they're essential for light, fluffy donuts. Oil temperature is critical: too cool=greasy donuts, too hot=burned outside/raw inside. Best eaten fresh.

steps: Mix flour with boiling water to form dough, let rest 10 minutes
Knead dough until smooth, cover and rest another 10 minutes
Mix ground pork with cabbage, ginger, garlic, green onions, soy sauce, sesame oil, and rice wine
Divide dough into 20 portions and roll each into thin circles
Place 1 tablespoon filling in center of each circle
Fold in half and pinch edges to seal, then fold one corner up and pinch to create distinctive pleated shape
Bring large pot of water to boil
Add dumplings carefully, stir gently to prevent sticking
Once dumplings float, cook 2-3 more minutes until they rise and stay at surface
Drain and serve hot with dipping sauce
recipe.tips: Keep dough covered to prevent drying. Dumplings can be frozen on a tray before cooking. Cook from frozen without thawing, adding 1-2 extra minutes.

steps: Bring water to boil in large pot
Add sea salt to taste (edamame should be salted water)
Add edamame pods and return to boil
Cook 5 minutes for frozen beans, or 3-4 minutes for fresh
Drain immediately in colander and spread on paper towels
Transfer to serving bowl while warm
Sprinkle with additional sea salt if desired
recipe.tips: Edamame are typically squeezed between teeth to extract the beans from the pod before eating. The pod itself is not eaten. Serve as appetizer either warm or cold.

dishes.name: Eggs Benedict
ingredients: Salt and white pepper to taste

steps: Prepare Hollandaise: Melt butter gently, whisk egg yolks with 1 tablespoon water over double boiler until thick
Remove from heat, slowly whisk in melted butter while whisking constantly
Season with lemon juice, cayenne pepper, salt, and white pepper
Toast English muffin halves and warm Canadian bacon slices in pan
Bring pot of water to gentle simmer with 1 tablespoon white vinegar
Create whirlpool in water with spoon, slide one egg into center
Cook 3-4 minutes until egg whites are set but yolk remains runny
Remove with slotted spoon and repeat with remaining eggs
Assemble: Place Canadian bacon on toasted muffin, top with poached egg
Drizzle generously with Hollandaise sauce and serve immediately
recipe.tips: Hollandaise must be kept warm (not hot) during service or it will break. If it does, whisk a new egg yolk in clean bowl and slowly whisk in broken sauce. The eggs must be absolutely fresh for poaching.

dishes.name: Escargots
ingredients: Salt and white pepper to taste

steps: Preheat oven to 200°C
Prepare garlic butter: Mix softened butter with minced garlic, parsley, shallots, salt, pepper, and nutmeg
Rinse canned escargots under cold water and pat dry
Place small amount of garlic butter in bottom of each shell
Insert one escargot into each shell
Fill opening of each shell with remaining garlic butter
Arrange escargots in special escargot pan (or on baking sheet) with opening facing up
Bake 8-10 minutes until butter is bubbling and escargots are heated through
Serve immediately in same pan or transfer to warm plate
Use small escargot fork to remove escargots from shells, or simply suck them out
recipe.tips: Classic French appetizer traditionally served with crusty bread to soak up the herbed butter. Escargot shells are reusable - wash and dry after use. Can be prepared ahead and baked just before serving.

dishes.name: Falafel
ingredients: Salt and black pepper to taste

steps: Drain soaked chickpeas thoroughly
Process chickpeas with onion, parsley, cilantro, and garlic until coarse paste forms
Mix in cumin, coriander, cayenne, salt, and pepper
Fold in flour and baking powder until combined
Refrigerate mixture for at least 30 minutes
Form into golf ball-sized spheres, slightly flattened
Heat oil to 175°C in deep fryer or pot
Carefully lower falafel into hot oil in batches
Fry 3-4 minutes until deep golden brown all over
Remove with slotted spoon and drain on paper towels
Serve warm with tahini sauce and pita bread
recipe.tips: Must use dried chickpeas soaked, not canned - canned will fall apart. The falafel mixture should feel sandy, not wet. Don't skip the chilling step. Serve immediately while still warm and crispy.

steps: Remove steaks from refrigerator 30 minutes before cooking to reach room temperature
Pat steaks completely dry with paper towels
Season generously with sea salt and freshly ground pepper on both sides
Heat cast iron skillet over high heat until smoking hot
Place steaks in skillet and do NOT move them for 4-5 minutes to develop crust
Flip steaks and cook other side 3-4 minutes for medium-rare (internal temp 135°F)
Add butter, garlic, and herbs to pan and tilt to baste steaks repeatedly with foaming butter
Transfer to warm plate and rest 5 minutes before serving
Slice if desired and serve with béarnaise sauce or fleur de sel
recipe.tips: Prime or Choice grade beef is essential. Room temperature before cooking is critical. Never pierce the meat while cooking - allows juices to escape. Rest period allows carryover cooking and juice redistribution. Most tender cut of beef.

dishes.name: Fish and Chips
ingredients: Salt and white pepper to taste

steps: Cut potatoes into thick chips (fries), soak in water 30 minutes, pat dry
Prepare batter: whisk flour, baking powder, salt, pepper with cold water until smooth consistency
Heat oil to 160°C for chips, fry in batches 5-6 minutes until just cooked but not golden
Remove chips and drain, increase oil temperature to 180°C
Pat fish fillets dry with paper towels
Dip fish fillets in batter to coat completely
Fry battered fish 4-5 minutes until golden brown and crispy
Increase oil temperature to 190°C for final crisping
Fry chips again 2-3 minutes until golden and crispy
Drain both on paper towels and serve hot with malt vinegar and salt
recipe.tips: Cold liquid is essential for crispy batter - don't use warm water. Double frying potatoes creates perfect fluffy interior with crispy exterior. Serve immediately with lemon wedge and mushy peas on side.

steps: Remove foie gras from refrigerator 5 minutes before serving to let warm slightly
Using a long, thin knife dipped in hot water between cuts, slice foie gras into 1cm thick slices
Wipe knife clean between each cut
Arrange slices on chilled plate
Season lightly with fleur de sel and freshly ground black pepper
If searing: heat non-stick pan over high heat, sear slices 10-15 seconds per side until golden
Drizzle with Sauternes reduction if desired
Serve immediately with brioche toast points, fig jam, or fresh oysters on side
recipe.tips: Foie gras is best served at room temperature to appreciate its creamy texture and buttery flavor. If slicing, keep knife hot and wipe between cuts to minimize damage to delicate liver. Classic accompaniment is Sauternes wine. Extremely rich - serve in small portions.

dishes.name: French Fries
ingredients: Oil for deep frying (peanut or vegetable oil)

steps: Cut potatoes into 1/4-inch thick sticks, keeping skin on for authenticity
Soak cut potatoes in cold water for at least 30 minutes to remove excess starch
Pat potatoes completely dry with paper towels - moisture prevents proper frying
Heat oil to 160°C (320°F) in deep pot or fryer
First fry: Cook potatoes in batches 5-7 minutes until they start to soften but aren't brown
Remove with slotted spoon and drain on paper towels - let rest 5 minutes
Heat oil to 190°C (375°F)
Second fry: Cook potatoes again 2-3 minutes until golden brown and crispy
Remove with slotted spoon and drain thoroughly on paper towels
Immediately season with sea salt while still hot
Serve hot in paper cone or basket
Add black pepper and fresh parsley if desired
recipe.tips: Double frying is key - low temperature first to cook through, high temperature second for crispiness. Soaking removes starch for fluffier interior. Pat very dry before frying. Russet potatoes are best for crispiness. Oil temperature is crucial - use thermometer. Serve immediately while hot and crispy. Skin-on gives authentic Belgian frites style.

dishes.name: French Onion Soup
ingredients: Salt and black pepper to taste

steps: Melt butter in large heavy pot over medium heat
Add sliced onions and cook 30-40 minutes, stirring frequently, until deeply caramelized and golden
Once onions are caramelized, deglaze pan with white wine, scraping up browned bits
Pour in beef stock and add bay leaves and thyme
Bring to simmer and cook 20 minutes to allow flavors to meld
Season to taste with salt and pepper
Preheat broiler or oven to 200°C
Toast baguette slices until golden
Ladle soup into oven-safe bowls, place on baking sheet
Top each bowl with toasted bread and 40g grated Gruyère
Broil until cheese is melted and golden brown, about 3-4 minutes
Serve immediately with extra cheese on side
recipe.tips: The caramelization of onions is essential - don't rush it. True French recipe uses beef consommé for richer flavor. Soup can be made ahead without cheese topping. Each person traditionally gets a whole egg added to their individual bowl before the bread and cheese.

steps: Whisk together eggs, milk, sugar, vanilla, cinnamon, nutmeg, and salt in shallow bowl
Heat butter in large skillet or griddle over medium heat until foaming
Dip each bread slice into egg mixture, coating both sides but not soaking - about 1 second per side
Place dipped bread slices on hot buttered skillet
Cook 3-4 minutes on first side until golden brown
Flip and cook 2-3 minutes on other side until golden
Transfer to serving plate and repeat with remaining bread
Dust with powdered sugar
Serve immediately with maple syrup
Optional: top with fresh berries, whipped cream, or cinnamon sugar
recipe.tips: Thick-cut bread like brioche or challah is essential - regular sliced bread falls apart. Don't oversoak the bread - 1 second per side max. Butter the pan well for golden brown crust. Medium heat prevents egg from burning before bread crisps. Serve immediately while warm. Cinnamon and nutmeg are traditional. French custardy interior with crispy exterior is the goal.

dishes.name: Fried Calamari
ingredients: 500g fresh squid (calamari), cleaned and sliced into rings

steps: Clean squid by removing outer skin and internal organs, rinse thoroughly
Cut squid bodies into rings about 0.5cm thick, keep tentacles whole
Pat squid completely dry with paper towels - moisture prevents crispy coating
Mix flour, cornstarch, salt, white pepper, garlic powder, and cayenne in shallow bowl
Heat oil to 180°C in deep fryer or pot
Working in batches, coat squid rings in flour mixture, shaking off excess
Carefully place coated squid into hot oil
Fry 2-3 minutes until light golden brown and crispy
Remove with slotted spoon and drain on paper towels
Serve immediately with fresh lemon wedges and marinara sauce
recipe.tips: Squid must be very dry before coating or batter won't stick and be crispy. Cook only 2-3 minutes - overcooking makes it tough. Cornstarch in coating creates extra crispiness. Serve immediately while still warm and crispy.

dishes.name: Fried Rice
ingredients: 300g cooked jasmine rice, day-old and chilled

steps: Use day-old rice that has been refrigerated - day-old rice fries better with less clumping
Heat 1 tablespoon oil in wok or large skillet over high heat
Pour beaten eggs into wok, scramble until cooked through, remove and set aside
Add remaining 1 tablespoon oil to wok
Add diced chicken or shrimp, stir-fry 2-3 minutes until cooked
Add garlic and cook 30 seconds until fragrant
Add peas, carrots, and green onions, stir-fry 1 minute
Add cold rice, breaking up clumps with spatula, stir-fry 2-3 minutes
Return eggs to wok, add soy sauce and sesame oil
Toss everything together for 1 minute and season with white pepper
recipe.tips: Cold, day-old rice is absolutely essential - fresh warm rice becomes mushy. High heat and constant stirring prevents sticking. Add any vegetables, proteins, or sauces you have on hand. Traditional addition is a fried egg placed on top.

steps: Combine Greek yogurt and milk in bowl and whisk until smooth
Add sugar and vanilla extract, whisk until sugar is completely dissolved
Pour mixture into ice cream maker
Churn according to manufacturer instructions, typically 20-25 minutes
Transfer to container and freeze until firm, about 2-3 hours
Or if no ice cream maker: Pour mixture into shallow pan, freeze 2 hours until slushy
Break up with fork every 30 minutes during freezing for granular texture
Scoop into serving bowls and top with fresh berries, granola, or honey
recipe.tips: Greek yogurt makes it creamier and tangier than regular frozen yogurt. For soft-serve texture, scoop directly from freezer. For firmer texture, freeze longer. Can be made ahead and stored in freezer up to 2 weeks.

steps: Preheat oven to 200°C
Mix softened butter with minced garlic, parsley, basil, salt, and pepper
Slice baguette lengthwise or halve if using ciabatta
Spread garlic butter generously on cut sides of bread
Optional: sprinkle grated Parmesan cheese on top
Wrap in foil and bake 8-10 minutes until heated through
Unwrap and bake another 2-3 minutes until edges are crispy
Serve hot as appetizer or alongside pasta dishes
recipe.tips: Can be prepared ahead and frozen before baking. Add herbs like oregano or thyme for variation. Serve immediately while warm and crispy.

steps: Boil potatoes in salted water until tender, about 15 minutes
Drain and peel while still warm
Rice potatoes into large bowl or press through ricer
Make well in center and add egg, salt, pepper, and nutmeg
Gradually mix in flour until soft dough forms - don't overwork
Divide dough into 4 portions, roll each into rope about 2cm diameter
Cut rope into 2cm pieces and press with fork to create ridges
Bring large pot of salted water to boil
Drop gnocchi in batches, stir gently to prevent sticking
Once gnocchi float, cook 2 more minutes until firm
Meanwhile, brown butter with sage leaves in pan
Toss drained gnocchi with sage butter and Parmesan
recipe.tips: Use starchy potatoes, not waxy. Work quickly to avoid tough gnocchi. Can be frozen on tray before cooking. Fresh gnocchi tastes far superior to store-bought.

dishes.name: Greek Salad
ingredients: Salt and black pepper to taste

steps: Cut tomatoes into chunks, removing excess seeds and juice
Dice cucumber and chop bell pepper
Thinly slice red onion and soak in cold water for 5 minutes to remove harshness
Pit Kalamata olives, or use pre-pitted ones
Cube Feta cheese into bite-sized pieces
In large bowl, combine tomatoes, cucumber, onion, bell pepper, and olives
In small bowl, whisk together olive oil, vinegar, and dried oregano
Pour dressing over vegetables and toss gently
Top with Feta cheese cubes
Season with salt and pepper to taste
Let sit 10 minutes before serving to allow flavors to blend
recipe.tips: Use the ripest tomatoes available and high-quality Feta cheese. Traditionally made with no lettuce - just fresh vegetables. Best served at room temperature. Can be prepared ahead and dressed just before serving.

dishes.name: Grilled Cheese Sandwich
ingredients: Salt and black pepper to taste

steps: Butter one side of each bread slice generously
Heat non-stick skillet or griddle over medium heat
Place 2 slices butter-side down on hot skillet
Layer cheese slices on bread (mix Cheddar and Gruyère for best flavor)
Top with second slice of bread, butter side up
Cook 3-4 minutes until bottom is golden brown
Carefully flip sandwich and cook 2-3 minutes until second side is golden
Remove from heat and cut diagonally
Serve hot while cheese is still melted
recipe.tips: Use good quality cheese for best results - avoid pre-sliced American cheese. Medium heat prevents bread from burning before cheese melts. Butter the outside of bread, not inside, for crispy exterior. Cut diagonally - it just tastes better this way.

dishes.name: Grilled Salmon
ingredients: Salt and freshly ground black pepper

steps: Preheat grill to medium-high heat (200°C) and oil grates
Pat salmon fillets dry with paper towels
Season both sides with salt and pepper
Brush skin side with olive oil
Place salmon skin-side down on hot grill
Cook 6-8 minutes without moving until skin is crispy and fish flakes easily
If desired, flip briefly to cook other side 1-2 minutes
Squeeze fresh lemon juice over salmon
Top with fresh dill and thyme
Serve hot with finishing butter if desired
recipe.tips: Salmon skin should be crispy and salmon cooked through to medium (internal temp 63°C). Don't move fish around on grill - let it develop char. Oil the grates, not the fish, to prevent sticking. Cook skin-side down for best results and crispy skin.

steps: Cut avocados in half lengthwise, remove pit by hitting with knife and twisting
Scoop flesh into bowl using spoon
Mash with fork to desired consistency - leave some chunks for texture
Immediately squeeze lime juice over avocado and stir to prevent browning
Add sea salt and stir gently
Fold in cilantro, tomatoes, onion, jalapeño, and garlic
Season with black pepper to taste
Taste and adjust lime juice and salt as needed
Transfer to serving bowl and serve immediately with tortilla chips
recipe.tips: Use avocados that yield slightly to pressure when gently squeezed. Lime juice prevents browning and adds essential flavor. Traditional recipe is simple - quality avocados and fresh lime are most important. Best served immediately after preparation.

dishes.name: Gyoza
ingredients: 12 gyoza wrappers (round or square wonton wrappers)
Dipping sauce: soy sauce, rice vinegar, chili oil

steps: In bowl, combine ground pork, cabbage, green onion, garlic, ginger, soy sauce, sesame oil, and salt
Lay out gyoza wrapper on flat surface
Place 1 teaspoon filling in center of wrapper
Wet edges of wrapper with water using finger
Fold wrapper in half to create crescent shape
Create 2-3 pleats on one side, pressing edge to seal
Place gyoza on parchment paper until ready to cook
Heat oil in skillet over medium-high heat
Place gyoza flat side down and cook 2-3 minutes until golden
Add 1/4 cup water and immediately cover with lid to steam
Cook 5-7 minutes until water is absorbed and bottoms are still crispy
Serve hot with dipping sauce of soy sauce, vinegar, and chili oil
recipe.tips: Don't overfill gyoza or they'll burst. Pleated edge creates authentic appearance and helps seal. Pan-fry first to get crispy bottom, then steam to cook filling. Wet fingers make wrapping easier. Fill on demand to prevent wrappers drying out. Soy-vinegar-chili oil dipping sauce is traditional.

dishes.name: Hamburger
ingredients: Salt and freshly ground black pepper
Optional: cheese slice (cheddar, American, or Swiss)

steps: Gently form ground beef into patty about 1cm thick, slightly larger than bun
Make small indentation in center with thumb - prevents bulging during cooking
Season generously with salt and pepper on both sides
Heat skillet or griddle over medium-high heat until very hot
Place patty on hot griddle and cook 3-4 minutes without moving
Flip and cook 2-3 minutes for medium doneness (internal temp 70°C)
If adding cheese, place on patty in last minute and cover to melt
Toast bun lightly in skillet with butter until golden
Build burger: bottom bun, condiments, patty with cheese, vegetables, top bun
Serve immediately while patty is warm
recipe.tips: Don't overwork the meat when forming patty - handle as little as possible. The indentation in center prevents the burger from puffing up during cooking. 80/20 ground beef has the right ratio for moisture and flavor. Don't press down on burgers while cooking - let them cook undisturbed for best crust.

dishes.name: Hot And Sour Soup
ingredients: 2 tablespoons cornstarch mixed with 3 tablespoons water
Optional: chili oil for extra heat

steps: Bring stock to boil in large pot
Add mushrooms and bamboo shoots, simmer 3-4 minutes
Add tofu cubes and simmer 2 more minutes
Add rice vinegar, soy sauce, and white pepper
Bring back to boil and taste - adjust heat and sour to preference
Stir cornstarch slurry and slowly pour into boiling soup while stirring constantly
Stir until soup thickens slightly, about 1 minute
Slowly drizzle beaten eggs into soup while stirring to create egg ribbons
Remove from heat and stir in sesame oil
Pour into serving bowls
Garnish with green onions
Serve immediately while hot
recipe.tips: White pepper is essential - gives authentic heat. Rice vinegar is crucial - don't substitute with regular vinegar. Cornstarch thickens and creates right texture. Drizzle eggs slowly while stirring for ribbon effect. Adjust heat and sour to preference before serving. Can add chili oil if you want more spice.

steps: Bring pot of water to boil or heat grill to medium-high
If boiling: submerge hot dog in water and simmer 5-7 minutes until heated through
If grilling: place hot dog on hot grill and cook 4-5 minutes, rolling occasionally for even charring
Toast bun lightly in skillet with butter until golden, 1-2 minutes
Place hot dog in toasted bun
Add desired toppings: mustard, ketchup, relish, onions, or sauerkraut
Serve immediately while hot
recipe.tips: Boiling keeps hot dogs juicy, grilling adds char and flavor. Never let hot dogs boil vigorously or they burst. Quality of sausage matters - seek out good quality beef hot dogs. Butter-toast the bun for better texture and flavor.

dishes.name: Huevos Rancheros
ingredients: 400g canned tomatoes or 3 fresh tomatoes, chopped

steps: Heat 1 tablespoon oil in skillet over medium heat
Sauté onion and garlic until softened, about 2 minutes
Add tomatoes, jalapeño, and cumin, simmer 10 minutes until sauce thickens
Season with salt and pepper to taste
Warm tortillas in dry skillet 30 seconds per side
Place tortillas on serving plate
Heat remaining oil in separate skillet
Fry eggs sunny-side up until whites are set but yolks still runny
Place fried egg on each tortilla
Spoon hot tomato sauce over eggs
Top with cheese and fresh cilantro
Serve with lime wedges on side
recipe.tips: Runny yolk is essential - serves as sauce. Canned tomatoes work fine for authentic results. Fresh cilantro and lime are traditional garnishes. Can make sauce ahead and reheat. Warm tortillas properly or they break. Cotija cheese is more authentic than cheddar.

dishes.name: Hummus
ingredients: Salt and white pepper to taste
2-4 tablespoons ice water (as needed for consistency)

steps: Drain and rinse canned chickpeas well, or use freshly cooked chickpeas
Add chickpeas, tahini, lemon juice, and garlic to food processor
Process until smooth, about 2-3 minutes
Add 2 tablespoons olive oil and process until combined
Add cumin, salt, and white pepper
Add ice water 1 tablespoon at a time while processing until desired consistency is reached
Transfer to serving bowl
Create shallow well in center with spoon
Drizzle remaining olive oil in well
Sprinkle with paprika, pine nuts, and fresh parsley
Serve with pita chips or fresh vegetables
recipe.tips: Tahini is essential - don't skip it. Lemon juice is crucial for flavor - fresh juice only. Ice water keeps hummus light and fluffy. Rinse canned chickpeas thoroughly to remove starch. Cumin is optional but traditional. Paprika and parsley add visual appeal. Best made fresh but keeps 3-4 days refrigerated.

dishes.name: Ice Cream
ingredients: Optional: 30g chocolate for chocolate ice cream
Optional: 120g fresh strawberries for strawberry flavor

steps: Combine heavy cream, milk, and sugar in saucepan
Heat over medium, stirring constantly until sugar dissolves - do not boil
Remove from heat and add vanilla extract and salt
Cool mixture to room temperature, then refrigerate for at least 4 hours or overnight
Pour chilled mixture into ice cream maker
Churn according to manufacturer instructions, typically 20-25 minutes
Transfer to freezer container and freeze for 4-6 hours until firm
For richer texture: make custard by heating cream, milk, sugar with egg yolks in double boiler until 71°C internal temp, then cool and churn
recipe.tips: Cold ingredients make better ice cream. The longer you chill the base, the better the texture. If no ice cream maker: freeze mixture in shallow pan, breaking up with fork every 30 minutes for 3 hours. Vanilla is classic, but add fruit purée, chocolate, or cookie pieces before churning for variations. Store in airtight container to prevent ice crystals.

dishes.name: Lasagna
ingredients: Salt and black pepper to taste

steps: Brown ground beef in large pot, drain excess fat
Add diced onion and cook 5 minutes until softened
Stir in minced garlic and cook 1 minute until fragrant
Add crushed tomatoes, tomato paste, beef broth, bay leaves, oregano, and basil
Simmer sauce 20 minutes, stirring occasionally
While sauce simmers, cook lasagna noodles according to package directions, drain and lay on parchment
Mix ricotta, egg, half the mozzarella, Parmesan, salt, and pepper in bowl
Preheat oven to 190°C
Spread thin layer of meat sauce on bottom of 9x13 baking dish
Layer 3-4 noodles, then ricotta mixture, then meat sauce - repeat layers 2-3 times
Top final layer with remaining mozzarella
Cover with foil and bake 25 minutes, remove foil and bake 15-20 minutes until cheese is bubbly
Let rest 10 minutes before serving
recipe.tips: Don't boil pasta fully - it will continue cooking in oven. The sauce should be thick, not watery. Can be assembled ahead and refrigerated before baking. Resting period is essential so lasagna doesn't fall apart when serving.

dishes.name: Lobster Bisque
ingredients: 700g lobster tails or whole lobster, chopped
Salt, white pepper, and cayenne to taste

steps: Melt butter in large pot over medium-high heat
Add lobster pieces and cook 3-4 minutes, stirring, until shells turn red
Add diced onion, carrots, and celery - cook 5 minutes until softened
Stir in garlic and tomato paste, cook 2 minutes
Carefully add brandy and ignite to burn off alcohol (optional, can skip)
Pour in seafood stock, add bay leaf and thyme
Bring to boil, reduce heat, simmer 30 minutes
Strain through fine mesh strainer, pressing gently to extract flavors from solids
Return strained liquid to pot
Stir in heavy cream and bring to gentle simmer
Season with salt, white pepper, and cayenne to taste
Serve hot with croutons and small piece of lobster meat for garnish
recipe.tips: Classic French soup - cream is essential for silky texture. Proper straining through fine mesh produces smooth soup without graininess. Can be made with crab or shrimp stock as well. Brandy adds traditional depth but alcohol can be omitted.

dishes.name: Lobster Roll Sandwich
ingredients: Salt and white pepper to taste
1 New England style hot dog bun

steps: Ensure lobster meat is chilled and broken into large chunks
In bowl, combine mayonnaise, lemon juice, and mustard
Gently fold in lobster meat, celery, and green onions
Season with salt and white pepper to taste
Taste and adjust seasonings - lemon juice should be noticeable
Butter the outside of hot dog bun generously
Toast bun in skillet or on griddle over medium heat until golden brown
Fill toasted bun with lobster mixture
Sprinkle lightly with paprika
Serve immediately with lemon wedge
recipe.tips: Use fresh, high-quality cooked lobster meat - this is most important. Don't overmix or you'll break up the lobster chunks. Cold lobster mixture in warm buttered bun is the classic combination. Celery adds traditional crunch. Some versions serve cold, others warm - both are valid.

steps: Cook macaroni in salted boiling water until al dente, drain and set aside
Melt 45g butter in saucepan over medium heat
Whisk in flour to make paste and cook 1 minute, stirring constantly
Slowly add milk while whisking to avoid lumps
Continue cooking and stirring until sauce is thick and creamy, about 5 minutes
Remove from heat and stir in grated Cheddar and Gruyère cheese until melted
Add mustard, salt, white pepper, and cayenne
Fold cooked macaroni into cheese sauce
Transfer to buttered baking dish
Toss panko breadcrumbs with 2 tablespoons melted butter and spread on top
Bake at 190°C for 20-25 minutes until golden and bubbly
recipe.tips: Béchamel sauce base is essential for creaminess. Mix of sharp Cheddar and Gruyère provides complex flavor. Don't overcook pasta initially - it continues cooking in oven. Panko topping adds nice texture. Can be assembled ahead and baked when needed.

dishes.name: Macarons
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract or food coloring
Filling: butter, powdered sugar, flavor of choice

steps: Process almond flour and powdered sugar together to make very fine flour
Sift mixture 3-4 times through fine-mesh strainer to remove lumps
Beat egg whites in clean bowl until soft peaks form
Gradually add granulated sugar while beating until stiff peaks form and mixture is glossy
Add vanilla or food coloring
Gently fold in almond-sugar mixture in 3 additions - don't overmix
When fully folded, mixture should be smooth and ribbon-like
Transfer to piping bag fitted with round tip
Pipe 2.5cm rounds onto parchment paper, spacing 2cm apart
Let rest 30 minutes at room temperature - shells should form
Preheat oven to 150°C (300°F)
Bake 15-18 minutes until set but NOT brown - shells should lift cleanly from parchment
Cool on baking sheet 10 minutes, then transfer to wire rack
Once completely cool, sandwich two shells with buttercream filling
recipe.tips: Macarons are finicky - volume of ingredients is critical. Egg whites must be room temperature. Don't overmix or they spread and won't develop feet. Resting period is essential - creates skin that forms the characteristic macaron feet. Low temperature and careful timing prevent cracking.

dishes.name: Miso Soup
ingredients: 800ml dashi stock (or water with dashi powder)
Optional: mushrooms, clams, or other proteins

steps: Soak dried wakame seaweed in warm water for 5 minutes until soft, then drain
Bring dashi stock to simmer in pot - do not boil
In small bowl, dissolve miso paste with 2-3 tablespoons of hot dashi liquid
Pour miso mixture back into pot slowly, stirring gently
Add softened wakame to pot
Add tofu cubes gently
Bring back to gentle simmer but never boil - boiling kills flavors and breaks tofu
Add optional proteins if using
Pour into serving bowls
Garnish with green onion slices
Serve immediately while hot
recipe.tips: Never boil miso soup once miso is added - heat damages probiotic cultures and flavors. Dashi stock is essential - use proper dashi powder if making stock. White miso is milder, red is stronger. Silken tofu is traditional. Wakame seaweed adds authenticity. Serve in small bowls - it's a light soup.

dishes.name: Mussels
ingredients: Salt and black pepper to taste

steps: Clean mussels thoroughly under running water, scrub shells with brush
Remove any beards (stringy bits) by pulling toward hinged side
Discard any mussels that are already open or have cracked shells
Melt butter in large pot over medium heat
Add sliced onion and cook 5 minutes until softened
Add garlic and cook 1 minute until fragrant
Pour in white wine and bring to boil
Add mussels, cover pot, and cook 5-7 minutes until shells open
Remove opened mussels to bowl, discarding any that remain closed
Add broth, bay leaves, and thyme to cooking liquid
Reduce liquid by half over medium-high heat, about 5 minutes
Stir in cream and adjust seasoning with salt and pepper
Return mussels to pot or arrange in bowls
Pour broth over mussels and garnish with parsley
recipe.tips: Discard any mussels that don't open during cooking. Soak mussels in cold water with cornmeal for 1 hour before cooking to help them purge sand. Don't overcook or they become rubbery. Traditionally served with crispy fries (moules-frites).

steps: Preheat oven to 200°C
Spread tortilla chips in single layer on baking sheet
Warm refried beans in saucepan and spread thin layer over chips
Brown ground beef in skillet and season with cumin, chili powder, salt, pepper
Sprinkle seasoned beef over bean layer
Top with shredded Cheddar cheese
Bake 8-10 minutes until cheese is melted and chips are warm
Remove from oven and top with sour cream drizzle
Add fresh cilantro, jalapeño slices, and avocado slices
Serve immediately with pico de gallo on the side and lime wedges
recipe.tips: Assemble on baking sheet not serving plate so everything cooks together evenly. Add toppings like guacamole and sour cream after cooking so they don't wilt. Bar-style nachos loaded with all toppings vs. simple cheese-and-bean version - both valid. Serve immediately while warm.

dishes.name: Omelette
ingredients: Salt and white pepper to taste
Optional fillings: cheese, mushrooms, ham, tomato, bell peppers

steps: Crack eggs into bowl and beat with fork until well combined
Season with salt and white pepper
Heat butter in non-stick skillet over medium-high heat until foaming
Once butter is bubbly, pour in beaten eggs
Let eggs set for 10 seconds, then gently push cooked portions toward center with spatula
Tilt pan so uncooked egg runs to edges
When top is mostly set but still slightly runny, add fillings to one half if desired
Fold omelette in half and slide onto warm plate
Garnish with fresh chives and serve immediately
recipe.tips: French omelette is different from American - it should be rolled, not folded, and slightly runny in center. Medium-high heat is essential. Don't overwork the eggs - let them cook gently. Fillings should be pre-cooked and warmed. Fresh herbs add elegance. Classic French version is plain with butter and chives only.

dishes.name: Onion Rings
ingredients: 1 cup cold sparkling water or beer
Optional: ranch dip or ketchup for serving

steps: Slice onions into 1/4-inch thick rings and separate layers
In bowl, whisk together flour, cornstarch, baking powder, salt, and cayenne
Pour cold sparkling water into flour mixture and whisk until smooth batter forms
Heat oil to 190°C (375°F) in deep pot or fryer
Working in batches, dip onion rings into batter, coating both sides
Carefully place battered rings into hot oil
Fry 2-3 minutes until golden brown and crispy
Remove with slotted spoon and drain on paper towels
Immediately season with sea salt while still hot
Repeat with remaining onion rings
Serve hot, optionally with ranch dip or ketchup
recipe.tips: Separate onion layers fully before battering for individual rings. Sparkling water or beer creates lighter, crispier coating than regular water. Don't overcrowd fryer or temperature drops. Oil must be at proper temperature or coating will be greasy. Serve immediately while hot and crispy. Sea salt while hot is essential.

dishes.name: Oysters
ingredients: Mignonette sauce: 60ml red wine vinegar, 1 shallot finely diced, salt and pepper

steps: Prepare oyster knife or sturdy short blade with guard
Fill large bowl or plate with crushed ice
Hold oyster in towel, flat side up, hinge pointing away from you
Insert knife tip into hinge between shells
Apply firm pressure and twist to open shell - be careful of sharp edges
Once open, slide knife along top shell to sever muscle, remove top shell
Run knife under oyster meat to sever bottom muscle but leave meat in shell
Remove any shell fragments from meat
Arrange opened oysters on bed of crushed ice
Prepare mignonette by combining vinegar, shallots, salt, and pepper
Serve oysters cold with mignonette sauce, lemon wedges, and optional hot sauce
recipe.tips: Fresh oysters should smell of the ocean and close when tapped - discard any that don't. Oyster varieties have distinct flavors - Beausoleil, Kumamoto, Malpeque are popular. Best served raw and very cold on ice. Mignonette is traditional accompaniment. Handle shells carefully - edges are sharp.

dishes.name: Pad Thai
ingredients: 2 tablespoons palm sugar or brown sugar

steps: Soak rice noodles in room temperature water for 30 minutes until pliable but still firm
Combine fish sauce, tamarind paste, and palm sugar in small bowl - this is the sauce
Heat 1 tablespoon oil in wok or large skillet over high heat
Add shrimp and cook until pink, about 2 minutes, remove and set aside
Add remaining 1 tablespoon oil and minced garlic, cook 20 seconds
Push ingredients to side, add beaten eggs, scramble lightly
Add drained noodles and sauce, toss everything together for 2-3 minutes
Return shrimp to wok, add green onions and half the bean sprouts
Toss everything together, cooking 1 minute until noodles are soft and coated in sauce
Transfer to serving plate and top with remaining bean sprouts and crushed peanuts
Serve with lime wedge on side
recipe.tips: Rice noodles should be soaked but not fully cooked before wok - they continue cooking. Wok cooking is very fast - have all ingredients prepped before starting. Tamarind paste is essential for authentic flavor - can't substitute lime. Fish sauce is essential ingredient. Balance of sweet, sour, salty is important.

dishes.name: Paella
ingredients: 200g seafood (shrimp, mussels, clams) or 200g chicken, diced
Salt and black pepper to taste
Fresh parsley and lemon wedges for serving

steps: Steep saffron threads in 2 tablespoons warm stock for 5 minutes
Heat olive oil in large paella pan (preferably 35-40cm) over medium heat
Add diced onion and cook 5 minutes until softened
Add minced garlic and cook 1 minute until fragrant
Add diced red pepper and cook 2 minutes
If using meat, add now and cook until browned
Add rice and stir constantly for 2 minutes to toast rice
Add white wine and let it reduce slightly
Pour in stock with saffron and add bay leaf and paprika
Bring to boil, then reduce heat to medium
Don't stir after this point - let rice absorb liquid and develop socarrat (crispy bottom)
After 15-18 minutes, when rice is almost tender, scatter seafood on top if using
Add peas and cook final 3-4 minutes until rice is tender and seafood is cooked
Remove from heat and let rest 5 minutes
Serve garnished with fresh parsley and lemon wedges
recipe.tips: Saffron gives authentic color and flavor - don't skip it. Short-grain rice is essential - won't turn into mush. Never stir after initial cooking - paella should develop crispy socarrat layer on bottom. Stock must be hot or cooking time is thrown off. Regional variations include seafood, meat, or mixed paella.

steps: Sift together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt in large bowl
In separate bowl, whisk milk, eggs, melted butter, and vanilla
Pour wet ingredients into dry ingredients
Mix until just combined - batter should be slightly lumpy, not overmixed
Heat griddle or non-stick skillet over medium heat
Lightly butter hot surface
Pour 1/4 cup batter per pancake onto griddle
Cook 2-3 minutes until bubbles form on surface and edges look set
Flip and cook other side 1-2 minutes until golden brown
Transfer to warm plate and repeat with remaining batter
Serve hot with maple syrup and butter
recipe.tips: Don't overmix batter - lumpy batter makes fluffier pancakes. Medium heat is essential - too hot and outsides burn while insides stay raw. Bubbles on surface indicate ready to flip. Keep finished pancakes warm in 100°C oven while cooking remaining batch. Serve immediately with hot maple syrup.

dishes.name: Panna Cotta
ingredients: 1 vanilla bean, or 1 teaspoon vanilla extract

steps: If using vanilla bean, split lengthwise and scrape seeds
Combine cream, milk, vanilla bean or extract, and sugar in saucepan
Heat over medium, stirring occasionally, until steaming (don't boil)
Remove from heat and let steep 10 minutes if using vanilla bean
Bloom gelatin by sprinkling over 2 tablespoons cold water and let sit 5 minutes
Strain warm cream mixture through fine mesh to remove vanilla bean and any lumps
Add bloomed gelatin to warm cream, stir until completely dissolved
Pour into ramekins or serving glasses
Chill for at least 4 hours or overnight until set
Serve chilled, optionally topped with raspberry coulis and fresh berries
recipe.tips: Don't boil the cream or the texture will be grainy. Proper blooming of gelatin is essential for smooth texture. Can be made up to 2 days ahead. To unmold: dip ramekin bottom in hot water for 5 seconds, run knife around edge, invert onto plate. Dessert of elegance and simplicity.

steps: Bring water to boil in large pot
Carefully place duck in boiling water for 2 minutes to soften skin
Remove duck and pat completely dry inside and outside with paper towels
Combine honey, soy sauce, and rice vinegar, brush all over duck skin
Hang duck in cool, breezy location (or use hair dryer on cool) for 4-6 hours to dry skin
Preheat oven to 200°C (400°F)
Place duck breast-side up on roasting rack in pan
Roast 30 minutes at 200°C (400°F), then reduce to 180°C (350°F) for 50-60 minutes
Duck is done when skin is deep mahogany brown and meat is tender
Remove duck and let rest 10 minutes
With sharp knife, carefully carve skin from duck in thin slices, trying to get skin with meat attached
Combine hoisin sauce, sesame paste, sugar, and garlic in small bowl
Warm mandarin pancakes in steamer or microwave
Serve carved duck with sauce, pancakes, cucumber, green onions, and cilantro on the side
recipe.tips: Blanching and drying the skin is crucial for crispiness. Honey-soy glaze creates that signature deep brown color. Hanging duck to dry creates the crispy skin that defines Peking duck. Slicing skin separately is traditional presentation. Mandarin pancakes can be found frozen in Asian markets.

dishes.name: Pho
ingredients: Garnishes: fresh basil, cilantro, lime, jalapeño, bean sprouts, hoisin, sriracha

steps: Blanch beef bones in boiling water for 2 minutes, rinse well
Char ginger and onion over flame until blackened for 30 seconds per side
In large pot, combine bones with 2 liters water, charred ginger, charred onion
Bring to boil, then reduce to simmer
Add star anise, cinnamon, and cloves
Simmer uncovered 2.5-3 hours until broth is rich and flavorful
Strain broth through fine sieve, discard solids
Return broth to pot and season with fish sauce, sugar, salt, and pepper
Keep broth hot
Cook rice noodles according to package directions, drain
Divide noodles among serving bowls
Arrange thinly sliced raw beef on top of noodles
Ladle hot broth over noodles and beef - beef will cook from residual heat
Serve immediately with fresh herb and condiment garnishes on side
recipe.tips: Beef broth is foundation - simmer long enough for deep flavor. Charring ginger and onion is essential. Star anise and cinnamon are traditional aromatics. Thinly sliced beef cooks from hot broth. Fresh herbs and squeeze of lime are crucial for final flavor. Can make broth ahead and refrigerate.

dishes.name: Pizza
ingredients: Extra virgin olive oil for drizzling

steps: Mix flour, salt, yeast in bowl
Add warm water and olive oil, mix until shaggy dough forms
Knead 10 minutes by hand or 5 minutes in stand mixer until smooth and elastic
Place in oiled bowl, cover, let rise 90 minutes until doubled
Divide into 2-4 portions and let rest 30 minutes
Preheat oven to 475°C on high heat, place pizza stone inside to preheat
Stretch dough gently into circle about 30cm diameter, place on floured peel
Spread thin layer of crushed tomatoes on dough, leaving border for crust
Distribute torn mozzarella over sauce
Slide pizza onto hot stone and bake 12-15 minutes until crust is golden
Remove from oven, top with fresh basil leaves and drizzle with excellent olive oil
Cool slightly and serve
recipe.tips: High heat and preheated stone are essential for authentic Neapolitan pizza. San Marzano tomatoes are traditional and make a difference. Don't overload toppings or pizza becomes soggy. Fresh basil should be added after baking. Less is more - simplicity is the mark of great pizza.

dishes.name: Pork Chop
ingredients: Salt and freshly ground black pepper

steps: Remove pork chops from refrigerator 20 minutes before cooking
Pat completely dry with paper towels
Season generously with salt and pepper on both sides
Heat olive oil in heavy skillet over medium-high heat until shimmering
Place pork chops in hot skillet and cook 5-6 minutes without moving until golden
Flip and cook 4-5 minutes more until internal temperature reaches 63°C
In final minute, add butter, garlic, and rosemary to pan
Tilt pan and baste chops with foaming herb butter
Remove to warm plate and rest 3-4 minutes
Spoon pan juices over chops
Serve with lemon wedges
recipe.tips: Thick-cut pork chops (2.5cm+) give better results than thin ones. Let meat come to room temperature before cooking. Don't move chops while searing - need time for crust. Pork should reach 63°C internal temperature - overcooking makes it dry. Resting is important for juice retention. Fresh herbs and quality butter elevate the dish.

dishes.name: Poutine
ingredients: 200g cheese curds (fresh mozzarella curds work as substitute)

steps: Cut potatoes into thick-cut fries (thicker than typical french fries), about 1/2-inch)
Soak cut potatoes in cold water for 30 minutes minimum
Pat potatoes completely dry with paper towels
Heat oil to 160°C (320°F)
First fry: Cook potatoes 8-10 minutes until just starting to soften but not brown
Remove and drain on paper towels, let rest 5 minutes
Heat oil to 190°C (375°F)
Second fry: Cook potatoes 3-4 minutes until golden brown and crispy
Drain on paper towels and immediately season with salt
Place hot fries in serving container
Top with fresh cheese curds (they'll soften slightly from heat)
Pour hot gravy over fries and cheese curds immediately
Gravy will melt cheese curds and combine with fries
recipe.tips: Fresh cheese curds are essential - must squeak between teeth. Canadian specialty, harder to find in US/elsewhere. Thick-cut fries are traditional, different from thin fries. Double-fry technique creates crispy exterior with fluffy interior. Hot gravy is crucial - must be hot enough to slightly melt curds. Assemble immediately before serving so fries stay crispy.

steps: Remove roast from refrigerator 2-3 hours before cooking to reach room temperature
Preheat oven to 135°C (for medium-rare)
Mix salt, pepper, garlic powder, thyme, and rosemary in small bowl
Pat roast dry with paper towels
Rub herb mixture all over the roast
Place on roasting pan bone-side down, ribs facing up
Roast approximately 20 minutes per 500g (internal temp 55°C for medium-rare)
Insert meat thermometer into thickest part without touching bone
Increase oven to 230°C for final 15 minutes to develop crust
Remove from oven and tent loosely with foil, rest 15-20 minutes before carving
Carve between bones and serve with pan drippings
recipe.tips: Room temperature meat cooks more evenly. Use meat thermometer for perfect doneness - Prime rib is expensive, don't overcook. Medium-rare (55-60°C) is ideal. Resting period is essential for juices to redistribute. Grade Prime is worth the investment - superior marbling. Can be served with au jus and horseradish.

steps: Mix brown sugar, paprika, chili powder, garlic powder, salt, and pepper to make dry rub
Pat pork shoulder dry and massage with dry rub, coating all sides
Place pork in slow cooker or Dutch oven
Pour apple cider vinegar over pork
If using slow cooker: cook on low 8 hours until meat shreds easily
If using oven: cover and roast at 150°C for 6-8 hours until tender
Remove pork from liquid and let cool slightly
Using two forks or meat claws, shred pork into bite-sized pieces
Heat barbecue sauce gently and mix with shredded pork
Toast buns lightly if desired
Fill buns with pulled pork mixture
Top with sliced onion and coleslaw if desired
Serve hot
recipe.tips: Slow cooker makes this foolproof - set and forget for 8 hours. Cut meat against the grain for easier shredding. Pork shoulder is perfect cut for this - becomes very tender with long cooking. Collects lots of flavorful liquid - don't discard, use for sandwiches. Can be made ahead and reheated.

dishes.name: Ramen
ingredients: 1 sheet nori seaweed, cut into strips

steps: Bring ramen broth to gentle simmer in large pot
Cook ramen noodles in separate pot of boiling salted water for 3-4 minutes until al dente
Drain noodles immediately and rinse briefly under cold water
Place noodles in serving bowl and pour hot ramen broth over them
Arrange toppings artfully on top: pork belly, soft-boiled egg half, bamboo shoots, corn, green onions
Place nori strips on side of bowl
Sprinkle with sesame seeds and white pepper
Serve immediately while broth is hot
recipe.tips: Fresh noodles work far better than dried. Broth quality is most important - homemade is best but quality instant is fine. Soft-boiled egg (6-7 minutes) with runny yolk is essential. Traditional tonkotsu broth is pork-bone based and takes hours to simmer - use quality instant as shortcut. Each region of Japan has different style.

dishes.name: Ravioli
ingredients: Salt and white pepper to taste

steps: Make pasta: mound flour on work surface, create well in center, crack eggs into well
Using fork, beat eggs and gradually incorporate flour from inside walls
Once mixture becomes paste, knead by hand 10 minutes until smooth and elastic
Wrap in plastic, rest 30 minutes
Meanwhile, mix ricotta, spinach, Parmesan, salt, pepper, and nutmeg for filling
Roll pasta dough thin using pasta machine or rolling pin
Cut into 5cm squares using knife or ravioli cutter
Place 1 teaspoon filling on each square
Brush egg yolk around edges, fold in half to create triangle, then bring corners together
Bring large pot of salted water to boil
Gently drop ravioli into water - they'll sink then float
Cook 3-4 minutes after they float, until tender
Meanwhile, heat butter in pan with sage leaves until butter turns golden
Remove ravioli with slotted spoon and toss gently with sage butter
Serve with Parmesan shavings and cracked pepper
recipe.tips: Homemade pasta requires practice and patience - don't rush it. Resting dough is essential. Ravioli can be made ahead and frozen on tray before cooking. Don't overcrowd pot when boiling. Sage butter is classic pairing. Spinach-ricotta is traditional filling but can use cheese, lobster, or mushroom.

steps: Preheat oven to 175°C (350°F), grease and flour two 23cm cake pans
Whisk together flour, salt, baking soda, and cocoa powder in bowl
In separate bowl, cream together sugar and oil until combined
Add eggs one at a time, beating well after each
Stir in vanilla extract and red food coloring until evenly colored
Alternately add flour mixture and buttermilk, starting and ending with flour
Fold in vinegar gently
Divide batter evenly between prepared pans
Bake 30-35 minutes until toothpick comes out clean
Cool in pans 10 minutes, then turn out onto wire racks
For frosting: Beat cream cheese and butter until fluffy, 2-3 minutes
Gradually add powdered sugar, beating until light and spreadable
Add vanilla extract and beat until combined
Once cake is completely cool, spread frosting between layers and on top and sides
recipe.tips: Red food coloring is essential for that iconic red color - the cocoa and vinegar react to create the red hue (no actual red velvet). Buttermilk is crucial for texture. Don't overmix batter or cake will be tough. Cream cheese frosting is traditional. Cool cakes completely before frosting or frosting will melt.

dishes.name: Risotto
ingredients: 750ml vegetable or chicken stock, kept warm
Salt and white pepper to taste

steps: Heat olive oil in large heavy-bottomed saucepan over medium heat
Add finely diced onion and cook 2-3 minutes until softened
Add minced garlic and cook 30 seconds until fragrant
Add rice and stir constantly for 2 minutes to toast grains
Deglaze pan with white wine, stirring until wine is absorbed
Begin adding warm stock one ladle at a time, stirring frequently
Add next ladle of stock only when previous ladle is almost absorbed
Continue this process for 18-20 minutes until rice is creamy and al dente
Rice should be slightly firm in center, not mushy
Remove from heat and stir in butter, cream, and Parmesan cheese
Taste and adjust seasoning with salt and white pepper
Serve immediately in warm bowls
recipe.tips: Constant stirring is essential - releases starch that creates creamy consistency. Stock must be warm - cold stock interrupts cooking. Arborio rice absorbs liquid while maintaining shape. Italian risotto is never dry - should flow slightly on plate. Final stir-in of butter and cream is mantecare and makes it luxurious.

steps: In large bowl, mix flour and salt
Add oil and mix until breadcrumb texture
Add warm water gradually and knead into stiff dough
Cover and let rest 30 minutes
Boil potatoes until just tender, 10 minutes, drain
Heat oil in pan, add mustard and cumin seeds until they pop
Add onions and cook 2-3 minutes until softened
Add ginger-garlic paste and cook 1 minute
Add boiled potatoes, green peas, coriander, garam masala, salt, pepper
Cook 5 minutes until well combined, let cool
Divide dough into 12 portions, roll each into thin triangle
Cut triangle in half to make two smaller triangles
Wet edges with water to seal
Form cone, fill with potato mixture, seal edges
Heat oil to 190°C (375°F)
Fry samosas in batches 3-4 minutes until golden brown and crispy
Serve with mint chutney or tamarind sauce
recipe.tips: Stiff dough is key - easier to work with than soft dough. Cool filling before wrapping or pastry gets soggy. Sealing edges well prevents oil from leaking in during frying. Oil must be hot enough or samosas will absorb oil and be greasy. Can be fried ahead and reheated in oven. Serve hot with chutney.

dishes.name: Sashimi
ingredients: 200g sushi-grade salmon or tuna, impeccably fresh
Shiso leaves or plastic leaf dividers

steps: Source only the finest sushi-grade fish from reputable fishmonger
Keep fish very cold - handle with wet hands to maintain temperature
Use extremely sharp, wet knife to slice fish against the grain at 45-degree angle
Each slice should be about 1/4-inch thick
Make one clean cut per slice - dragging ruins the fish
Arrange slices on chilled plate, slightly overlapping
Decorate plate with thin-sliced daikon radish arranged in heap
Add shiso leaf or traditional leaf divider
Place small dollop of wasabi on side of plate
Serve with small dish of soy sauce for dipping
Optional: serve with pickled ginger
recipe.tips: Sushi-grade is essential - regular fish has parasites dangerous when raw. Only use from trusted source. Sharp knife is critical - dull knife tears fish. Keep everything very cold. Let fish come to room temperature 2-3 minutes before serving for best flavor. No cooking involved - this is raw fish. Simplicity is the point - quality of fish is star.

dishes.name: Scallops
ingredients: Salt and freshly ground white pepper

steps: Pat scallops completely dry with paper towels - moisture prevents browning
Season lightly with salt and white pepper
Heat oil and 1 tablespoon butter in heavy skillet over high heat
When butter foams, place scallops in pan without crowding
Cook 2-3 minutes without moving to develop golden crust
Flip scallops and cook 2-3 more minutes until opaque
In final minute, add remaining butter, garlic, and thyme
Tilt pan and baste scallops with foaming herb butter
Add lemon juice at the very end
Transfer to serving plate
Garnish with fresh parsley
recipe.tips: Dry scallops thoroughly - moisture is enemy of browning. Don't move scallops while cooking - need time for crust. Overcooking makes scallops rubbery - they cook quickly. High heat is essential for golden exterior. Fresh, not frozen, scallops are best but frozen work. Lemon juice should be added at end to preserve brightness.

steps: If using dried seaweed, soak in room temperature water for 5-10 minutes until soft
Drain seaweed well and pat dry with paper towels
In small bowl, whisk together rice vinegar, soy sauce, sesame oil, sugar, garlic, and ginger
If using chili flakes, add to dressing
Toast sesame seeds in dry skillet over medium heat for 1-2 minutes until fragrant
Pour dressing over seaweed and toss gently
Mix in toasted sesame seeds
Let marinate in refrigerator at least 30 minutes before serving
Stir before serving to redistribute dressing
Serve cold as appetizer or side dish
recipe.tips: Mixed seaweed varieties give interesting texture. Don't soak dried seaweed too long or it becomes mushy. Toasting sesame seeds brings out flavor. Rice vinegar is essential - don't substitute. Chilling before serving allows flavors to develop. Keeps 3-4 days refrigerated. Light and healthy appetizer.

steps: Heat chicken stock in saucepan until simmering
Slowly whisk cornmeal into stock, stirring constantly to prevent lumps
Cook grits 20-25 minutes, stirring frequently until creamy and tender
Stir in milk, butter, and cheddar cheese until melted and smooth
Season with salt and pepper, keep warm
While grits cook, fry bacon in separate pan until crispy, remove and set aside
In bacon fat, sauté onion until softened, add garlic and cook 1 minute
Add white wine, bring to simmer, reduce by half
Add shrimp and lemon juice, cook 2-3 minutes until shrimp just pink
Return bacon to pan, season shrimp with salt and pepper
Serve creamed grits topped with shrimp mixture
Garnish with fresh parsley
recipe.tips: Don't skip the salt in grits water - essential for flavor. Stir grits constantly or they clump. Don't overcook shrimp or they become rubbery. Grits should be pourable, not stiff. Cheddar can be sharp white cheddar for more flavor. Cook components separately for better timing.

dishes.name: Spaghetti Bolognese
ingredients: Salt and black pepper to taste

steps: Heat olive oil in large heavy pot over medium-high heat
Add pancetta and cook until fat renders, about 3 minutes
Add diced onion, carrot, and celery (soffritto) and cook 8-10 minutes until very soft
Add minced garlic and cook 1 minute until fragrant
Add ground beef and cook, breaking apart with spoon, until fully browned
Stir in tomato paste and cook 2 minutes
Deglaze with red wine and let it reduce by half
Add crushed tomatoes and bay leaves
Reduce heat to low and simmer uncovered for 45-60 minutes, stirring occasionally
Stir in milk and continue simmering 15 minutes more
Season with salt and pepper to taste
Cook spaghetti according to package directions in salted boiling water
Drain pasta and serve topped with Bolognese sauce and grated Parmesan
recipe.tips: Long, slow cooking develops deep flavor. The milk adds richness and slightly curdles - this is authentic. Soffritto base is essential. Real Bolognese is slow-cooked meat sauce, not just meat in tomato sauce. Can be made ahead and reheated. Traditional recipe uses no cream.

dishes.name: Spaghetti Carbonara
ingredients: Salt and freshly ground black pepper to taste

steps: Bring large pot of salted water to boil and cook spaghetti according to package directions until al dente
While pasta cooks, cut guanciale into small dice
Cook guanciale in large skillet over medium heat until fat renders and meat is crispy, about 5 minutes
In bowl, beat egg yolks with heavy cream, grated Pecorino, salt, and generous grinding of black pepper
When pasta is al dente, reserve 250ml pasta water, then drain pasta
Add hot drained pasta to pan with guanciale and fat
Remove pan from heat (important - overcooking scrambles eggs)
Quickly toss pasta while adding egg mixture
Add pasta water a few tablespoons at a time, tossing constantly, until sauce becomes creamy
Serve immediately in warm bowls, topped with extra Pecorino and black pepper
recipe.tips: Never let sauce get too hot or eggs will scramble. Guanciale (cured pork jowl) is traditional and worth seeking out - pancetta is acceptable substitute. Pecorino Romano is essential - Parmesan changes the dish. Pasta water starch is crucial for creamy sauce without cream. Rome natives use pecorino and no cream.

dishes.name: Spring Rolls
ingredients: 12 spring roll wrappers (rice paper or wheat-based)
Dipping sauce: hoisin, peanut sauce, or sweet chili sauce

steps: Fill shallow bowl with warm water for soaking rice paper
Lay out clean towel on work surface for assembling rolls
Prepare all fillings and have within reach
Soak 1 rice paper in warm water for 10-15 seconds until pliable but still firm
Place softened rice paper on towel
Layer ingredients in center of rice paper: lettuce, herbs, noodles, cucumber, carrot, shrimp, pork
Fold bottom of rice paper up over filling, fold in sides, then roll tightly into cylinder
